profile.headline: Senior Frontend Engineer
profile.summary:
With over a decade of experience as a frontend engineer, I specialize in building modern, scalable web applications using TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, and CSS. 

Currently, I am a Senior Frontend Engineer at NVIDIA, where I contribute to innovative product launches and user-focused solutions that push the boundaries of technology.

Throughout my career, I’ve led and executed successful projects for industry leaders such as Salesforce, Expedia, and E*Trade, impacting thousands of users with high-quality, performance-driven web applications. My approach combines deep technical knowledge with a passion for clean design and flawless user experiences.

I take pride in mentoring teams, collaborating across disciplines, and translating complex requirements into intuitive interfaces. My commitment to continuous learning ensures I always bring the latest best practices and fresh perspectives to every challenge.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborated closely with product and design teams to enhance the investing section of the web application, resulting in an improved user experience for over 3,500 financial advisors managing more than 70,000 accounts.

Developed a reporting feature using Highcharts, enabling advisors to compare portfolios and download reports in PDF format, thereby enhancing data analysis capabilities and decision-making processes.

Optimized the performance of our GraphQL orchestration layer by meticulously refactoring queries, leveraging Node.js capabilities and GraphQL best practices to enhance system efficiency and responsiveness.

Contributed significantly to the migration effort of our codebase to TypeScript, converting JavaScript files to TypeScript, which streamlined development processes, improved code quality, and enhanced maintainability.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · React.js · GraphQL · Node.js · Figma · styled-components · HTML5

positions.title: Front-End Engineer
positions.description:
Launched two projects simultaneously: a publishing tool which allowed Mulesoft partners to onboard public assets to the Anypoint Exchange; and a Marketplace prototype for Mulesoft Anypoint Exchange, meeting milestones against an aggressive delivery deadline.

Adopted a design system which improved the user experience while adhering to Mulesoft look and feel.

Successfully completed multiple proof-of-concept tasks, including collaboration with cross-functional teams to implement a REST client on the Marketplace prototype.

Designed a coding standards document which served as a frontend guide for both the Marketplace and the publishing tool

Had the opportunity to mentor an intern, helping her to develop the frontend skills and knowledge needed to complete a Slack integration on the publishing tool.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Next.js · React.js · SCSS · Node.js · Figma · Kubernetes · Jenkins · JavaScript · HTML5

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Successfully completed the migration of the Hotwire Hotel app from AngularJS to React.js improving the UI and reducing the loading time of the application.

Played a role in creating a global library of reusable React components for use across Hotwire's various business units.

Collaborated with product and design teams to develop and implement new features.

Worked closely with cross-functional teams to roll out a new feature from start to finish, including coding tasks in multiple projects (hotel search, hotel details, hotel checkout).

Created an onboarding document to help new engineers quickly become familiar with the project and get up to speed.

Designed and implemented a Splunk query that generated alerts when a certain percentage of API requests resulted in errors within a specified time frame.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Redux.js · LESS · Node.js · Express.js · Splunk · GraphQL · PagerDuty · Figma · Webpack · Jenkins · Datadog · HTML5

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Worked as a mentor on a program where I had 3 Jr Devs under my supervision. Provided them with a project where I helped them get more experience using Git and the code review process. They were able to complete the task and improve their Merge Requests as well as their Javascript skills.

Worked on the initial setup of a project for Williams Senoma, building markup, styles and configuring Webpack; eventually I delegated the project to the Jr Devs.

Participated with Talent Acquisition conducting technical interviews for frontend developers.

positions.title: Software Developer (Google Contractor)
positions.description:
Worked as a contractor for Google at their Sunnyvale Office. 
Participated in the migration process of Google App Maker legacy code, using frontend technologies.
Helped the team building Angular components for the application focusing on Angular Reactive Forms. Angular, Angular Material, SCSS, NgRx, RxJs

positions.title: Technical Interviewer
positions.description: Participated as part of the Talent Acquisition team conducting technical interviews of candidates, focusing on Frontend

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked as a consultant for E*Trade, where I participated in the construction of a new feature to their web trading app using React and MobX. 
The project was an investment calculator that allowed the users to see how their investments would behave given a period of time.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Worked as a consultant for USAA Bank.
Participated in the early adoption of frontend technologies for their banking system. 
Created prototypes using React, Redux and implemented unit testing using Jest, Mocha and Chai.
Implemented workarounds to provide complete solutions, since the NPM registry was blocked and the client had its own artifactory.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
During my time in Globant I was assigned to the Digital Content Studio, where I worked mainly developing the frontend of different projects, which included clients like Pernod Ricard, Scholastic, EMC, among others.
I had the opportunity of working with multicultural teams remotely. This included people from Colombia, Argentinca, Uruguay, USA, India, etc.
On the Digital Content Studio, we worked with different technologies, and i had the chance to work with PHP: (Drupal)
Java: AEM [Adobe Experience Manager] and Oracle ADF [Application Development Framework]). 
On the frontend side we included technologies like Grunt, SASS, LESS, Bootstrap, among others.
Participated as a mentor in one of my projects for one of the junior developers, achieving her tasks completion on a timely manner.
positions.insights: Skills: LESS · SCSS · Node.js · PHP · CSS3 · Twitter Bootstrap · jQuery · Adobe Experience Manager

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Participated in the creation of various websites, landing pages and marketing campaigns for many of the biggest brands in Mexico (Telcel, Televisa, Danone, Yves Rocher, Pepsico, etc).
Implemented Facebook API to fetch user data for marketing purposes.
Implemented Google Analytics for tracking user activity.
Gained experience with Google Maps API.
Worked mostly with HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
Improved javascript skills given the high usage of third party APIs and DOM manipulation to produce great user experiences.
positions.insights: Skills: LESS · CSS3 · Twitter Bootstrap · jQuery · Photoshop · HTML5

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
During my time at Zenit i was responsible of many frontend projects, including clients like Starbucks, American Express, Pfizer, among others.
I also contributed in the implementation of new modules to a web application.
Most of my work was based on HTML, CSS, Javascript and PHP.
I used tools like Twitter Bootstrap, Wordpress, Codeigniter, Facebook and Twitter API's, among others.
positions.insights: Skills: MySQL · PHP · CSS3 · Twitter Bootstrap · WordPress · jQuery · HTML
